simple.summary: צַח (tsach) means dazzling , i.e. sunny , bright , (figuratively) evident First listed occurrence: Isa 18 4.

definitions.full: H6703. tsach צַח adjective dazzling, glowing, clear ; — צַח חֹם Isa 18:4 glowing heat ; צַח רוּחַ Jer 4:11 glowing wind ; וְאָדוֺם צַח דּוֺדִי Song 5:10 my beloved is dazzling (white) and ruddy (compare Lam 4:7 ); feminine plural צַחוֺת לְדַבֵּר Isa 32:4 to speak clear (words), clearly .
